# Before the session {background-color="#E3120B" style="color:#F7F4ED"}

::: {style="margin-top: 1.0em; color:#F7F4ED"}
### Is the multinational the object of diplomacy, its instrument — or a diplomat?
:::

## What to do, and how long it takes

| | | |
|---|---|---|
| **1** | Read Rose (2007), Putnam (1988), Bjola & Manor (2018) | 80 min |
| **2** | Download Lowy GDI, IMF exports, WDI GDP | 20 min |
| **3** | Self-check | 15 min |

## 1 · Read

| | |
|---|---|
| **Rose (2007)** | *The World Economy* 30(1): 22–38 · [doi](https://doi.org/10.1111/j.1467-9701.2007.00870.x) · **the target** |
| **Putnam (1988)** | *International Organization* 42(3): 427–460 · [doi](https://doi.org/10.1017/S0020818300027697) · first half |
| **Bjola & Manor (2018)** | *Cambridge Review of International Affairs* 31(1): 3–32 · [doi](https://doi.org/10.1080/09557571.2018.1476836) |

Annotate: Rose's **claim, data, effect size** · the **reverse-causality** objection · the **win-set** · what **digital** changes at Level II

## 2 · Get the data

::: {.step}
**Lowy GDI** → `downloads/DataDownload.xlsx` — one sheet per year (use **2023**; the 2019 sheet is incomplete), one row per **post**
:::

::: {.step}
**IMF IMTS** → goods exports, FOB, US$ (`XG_FOB_USD`), **2023** — Canada + four other Lowy countries × all partners
:::

::: {.step}
**WDI** → `NY.GDP.MKTP.CD`
:::

::: {.warn}
Lowy lists posts that **exist**. "No post" is not a zero in the file — it is a missing row.
:::

## 3 · Self-check

1. Why can a **small** win-set strengthen a negotiator?
2. Two explanations of Rose's correlation **other** than export promotion
3. One instrument of commercial diplomacy besides embassies — and a firm that used it
4. One **investment-screening** case you know

## Arrive with

::: {.check}
- Three readings annotated
- Lowy, IMF and WDI files in `data/raw/`
- Self-check on paper
- **GSDB file received** for Session 10
:::
